text: An always-on agent keeps work moving across your tools and projects and reaches out with results or decisions that need you
quote: Your dot is an always-on agent that keeps work moving across your tools and projects. You can keep talking to it while it works, and it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.

text: Runs in the cloud with its own computer and browser, so it keeps working even when your computer is off
quote: your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser. You can reach it and it can keep working even when your computer is off.

text: Customize the agent's name and look, including shape, color, eyes, glasses, and accessories
quote: Give your dot a name and choose its shape, color, eyes, glasses, and accessories. You can change these anytime.

text: Start a voice call with the agent in ChatGPT and type messages while talking
quote: In ChatGPT, select the phone button in your dot's conversation to start a call. You can also type messages while you're talking.

text: The same agent and its memory are available across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls
quote: You reach the same dot in ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, or a call. Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.

text: Tell the agent which channel to use for each kind of update, such as routine progress in ChatGPT and decisions in Slack
quote: ask it to keep routine progress in ChatGPT and bring decisions to you in Slack.

text: Message the agent directly in Slack, or add it to a channel and mention it in threads
quote: In Slack, you can send a direct message or add your dot to a channel and mention it in a thread.

text: Uses background agents to work on several tasks in parallel while you keep talking to it
quote: It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.

text: Take over the agent's computer manually, then return control so it can continue
quote: open its computer and select Take over. Select Return control when you're ready for your dot to continue.

text: Connect your own computer so the agent can use your local files, code, and apps
quote: Connect your computer once through your dot's profile to make its local files, code, and apps available for your dot's work.

text: Connect Gmail, Google Drive, calendar, and files so the agent can find email and read and update documents
quote: connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents, or GitHub to investigate an issue and prepare a pull request.

text: Connect GitHub so the agent can investigate issues and prepare pull requests
quote: connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents, or GitHub to investigate an issue and prepare a pull request.

text: Delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex, and inspect the delegated work in an Activity view
quote: Your dot can delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex. In the desktop app, open your dot's profile and select Activity to inspect delegated work

text: Schedule recurring tasks, such as checking a channel every weekday at a set time and updating a checklist
quote: Check the connected planning channel each weekday at 9 AM Central for the next four weeks. Update my checklist when a deadline changes.

text: Monitor a Slack channel for new bug reports, investigate them, and prepare fixes for your review
quote: ask it to investigate new bug reports in a connected Slack channel and prepare fixes for your review.

text: When a website needs a login, the agent sends a private form where you enter your credentials
quote: When a website needs a login, your dot can send a request with a private form. Enter your credentials there

text: Optionally save logins to Passwords for future sign-ins
quote: When offered, Save to Passwords lets you save a login for future sign-ins. Saving is optional.

text: Create tasks in an existing Codex cloud environment, even while your computer is offline
quote: Create a task in a Codex cloud environment you have already set up. Your computer can be offline.

text: Create local Work or Codex tasks and continue existing local Codex tasks
quote: Your dot can create local Work or Codex tasks and continue existing local Codex tasks.

text: Define rules that set how the agent should handle specific actions
quote: Select Add, describe the action, choose how your dot should handle it, and select Add rule.

text: Inherits your ChatGPT app permissions, with granular control such as reading email without sending it
quote: Your existing ChatGPT app permissions apply to your dot. For example, you can allow it to read email without allowing it to send email.

text: Pause the agent's current main task without stopping delegated tasks or future scheduled runs
quote: Pause stops your dot's current main task. It doesn't stop every delegated task or cancel future scheduled runs.

text: Keeps its own notes on your preferences, decisions, and ongoing work for use in later conversations
quote: It also keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations.

text: Proactively flags conflicts, such as a decision that contradicts a draft you shared earlier
quote: your dot might flag that a release decision conflicts with a draft you shared last week.

text: Investigate bugs, implement changes, and run builds using permitted local repositories and developer tools
quote: Investigate bugs, implement changes, and run builds using permitted local repositories, developer tools, and skills.

text: Open the same agent in the ChatGPT mobile app
quote: After setup, you can open the same dot in the ChatGPT mobile app when the supporting update is available.
